inspiration.observed_pattern: A PostgreSQL cleanup script uses correlated NOT EXISTS predicates to select orphaned rows and a separate data-changing CTE with RETURNING to count deleted rows.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Combine those portable behaviors in an independently authored archive insert: correlated EXISTS admits only accounts with enabled entitlements, inserts them in deterministic ID order, and returns generated archive IDs.

fixture_notes: Accounts with at least one enabled entitlement are archived; an account with only disabled entitlements and an account with no entitlements are excluded by EXISTS.
determinism_notes: Fixed account and entitlement values, explicit source ordering, and auto-increment archive IDs created in that order; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE accounts (account_id INT PRIMARY KEY, account_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE entitlements (account_id INT NOT NULL, entitlement_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, enabled TINYINT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE account_archive (archive_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, account_id INT NOT NULL, account_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: INSERT INTO account_archive (account_id, account_name) SELECT a.account_id, a.account_name FROM accounts AS a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entitlements AS e WHERE e.account_id = a.account_id AND e.enabled = 1) ORDER BY a.account_id RETURNING archive_id, account_id, account_name

checks.sql: SELECT archive_id, account_id, account_name FROM account_archive ORDER BY archive_id
SELECT account_id, entitlement_name, enabled FROM entitlements ORDER BY account_id, entitlement_name
